claims.text: For \(a=\min(n-r-i,r-j)\), \(b=\min(i,j)\), \(J_v\subset H^\star(G/P_J,\mathbb Z)\cong\Lambda/I_{r,n-r}\) is generated as an ideal by \(\{s_\mu:i^j\subseteq\mu\subseteq((i+a)^b,i^{j-b})\}\). [source-2@L1382-L1401|claim=formal-document]
Under the recorded integral graded presentation hypotheses and the accepted degreewise certificates, if \(a=1,b=2\), then \(Q=J_v/A_+J_v\cong\mathbb Z^3\).
